info.title: FieldLoop internal mock patrol app
info.description: Synthetic read-only simulator endpoint from architecture section 4.2. Not a web-api/BFF endpoint. Run behind Cloud Run invoker IAM in dev/demo; local reads need no credentials. No real patrol-app connector, no write operation and no Signal publication.

get.description: Return the deterministic synthetic right-of-way findings for DL-01, oldest first, each with a GPS fix. Optional filters narrow by kind and by observation time. This bounded internal fixture list is not the paginated public platform list API.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Timezone-aware RFC 3339 time; only findings observed at or after it.

400.description: Invalid query; code validation_failed, input values are not echoed.

405.description: Only GET is allowed; code validation_failed. No state mutation.

serviceIdentity.description: Verified by Cloud Run invoker IAM, not proxy headers. The handler does not implement browser auth or independently validate IAM.
